entities.summary: Markus Nutivaara is a Finnish professional ice hockey defenceman, playing for Kölner Haie of the Deutsche Eishockey Liga. Nutivaara was selected by the Columbus Blue Jackets in the 7th round of the 2015 NHL Entry Draft. He has previously played for the Blue Jackets and Florida Panthers in the NHL and the Oulun Kärpät of the Liiga.
